programme-planning.module.name: Programme planning
programme-planning.module.description: Work out a season's programme on a board before it is scheduled: what might be programmed, where and when it goes, and what would stop it publishing.
programme-planning.settings.board.change: The time between shows in a space whose planning profile sets none. Never shorter than the theatre's turnaround.
programme-planning.settings.board.snap.h: What a show dropped on the board lines up with.
programme-planning.settings.board.day-st: The first hour a new plan's board shows in Day view.
programme-planning.settings.board.day-en: The last hour a new plan's board shows. 00:00 means midnight.
programme-planning.settings.publish.prod: Whether publishing a new plan also publishes the placed productions still in draft. Each plan can change it.
programme-planning.settings.notices.send: Whether acts are told their slots when the plan is published, or only when a programmer presses Tell acts.
Only when a programmer presses Tell acts
programme-planning.settings.notices.gath: How long to wait after a slot moves before telling the act, so several moves make one message.
programme-planning.settings.plans.close-: Close a plan after the season
When a season's plan closes, once the season has ended.
programme-planning.settings.retention.un: How long a declined or withdrawn entry is kept. This is a starting point, not legal advice.
programme-planning.abilities.entry.manag: Add and edit a plan's entries

programme-planning.plan.none.description: Start a plan to work out {season} on the board.

programme-planning.entry.bring-none: Every draft production of this season is already on the board.
